name: InstitutionSpecificRestriction
summary: The card component of Institution Specific Restriction (DUO_0000028). It reads AffiliationCredential, compares them with its policy data, and outputs the DownloadGrantCredential that Grant download takes.

allowedInstitutions.description: Institution DIDs the owner allows. An AffiliationCredential qualifies if claims.isMemberOf is in this list.
